rows.label: Magnus Prime relics
rows.note: buy extra Barrel relics: every one carries it as the Rare

conditions: Her stock rotates away; relics and Aya you hold never expire.
Vaulted relics and the parts themselves still trade between players.
bonuses: Varzia is also in the Market's Prime Resurgence tab.

rows.label: Magnus Prime Blueprint
rows.note: Lith H8 or Lith Z3 or Meso B6 or Meso S15 or Neo N18 or Axi C7 or Axi K10 or Axi S14 or Axi T10, Common: 25.33% Intact

rows.label: Magnus Prime Barrel
rows.note: Meso M5 or Neo M4 or Axi M2, Rare: 10% Radiant

rows.label: Magnus Prime Receiver
rows.note: Neo C2 or Neo C3 or Neo G4 or Neo N19 or Neo N22 or Neo T5 or Axi T8, Uncommon: 20% Radiant

conditions: Refine the Barrel and Receiver relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each); leave Blueprint relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds to 16.67%.
Mission rewards never drop Resurgence relics; Varzia is the only source.
Axi M5, a Baro Ki'Teer exclusive relic, carries all three parts; he sells it on some visits only.
bonuses: Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
